resolution.note: slice run keeps the review series across a same-ref rebase; --budget-exception passthrough; observer test/slice/slice-run.test.ts

title: slice run keeps the review series count across a same-ref rebase
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run` resets its review attempt count only when the review series actually starts over; after a rebase onto a new main SHA with the same baseRef it keeps the series count and stops with the budget-exception instruction before calling review.
Evidence: PR #212 (t-sa7ag03): slice run verify reset reviewAttempts to 0 on a new base (src/slice/run.ts "a new base starts a new series"), but the series is keyed by PR and baseRef `main`, so the next review exited 64 "two attempts exhausted"; attempt 3 then ran by hand with --budget-exception, and slice run has no --budget-exception passthrough.
Proof: slice observer: rebase onto a moved main after two FAIL attempts → no review call, exit 64 naming the exception path; with `--budget-exception <file>` the review argv carries it.
